  METHOD chk_stms.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_imp,
             trkorr  TYPE trkorr,
             retcode TYPE i,
             rc_raw  TYPE tpalog-retcode,
             impdate TYPE d,
             imptime TYPE t,
             impuser TYPE syuname,
             as4text TYPE as4text,
           END OF ty_imp.
    DATA: lt_imp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_imp WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_ts1 TYPE tpalog-trtime,
          lv_ts2 TYPE tpalog-trtime.

    lv_ts1 = |{ ms_win-d_from }{ ms_win-t_from }|.
    lv_ts2 = |{ ms_win-d_to }{ ms_win-t_to }|.

    "Read TPALOG (STMS import history) for current system in time window
    SELECT trkorr, trtime, retcode, truser, admin
      FROM tpalog
      WHERE tarsystem = @SY-sysid
        AND trtime BETWEEN @LV_ts1 AND @LV_ts2
        AND trkorr LIKE '___K%'
      ORDER BY trtime DESCENDING
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_log).

    "Deduplicate by TRKORR: keep worst return code per transport in window
    SORT lt_log BY trkorr retcode DESCENDING trtime DESCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_log COMPARING trkorr.

    IF lt_log IS INITIAL.
      add( iv_metric = 'Transport imports in window'
           iv_value  = 0
           iv_vtxt   = 'No imports in time window'
           iv_sev    = gc_ok
           iv_msg    = |No transports imported into { sy-sysid } in selected window| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    "Read short texts of transport requests (E07T)
    SELECT trkorr, langu, as4text
      FROM e07t
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @LT_log
      WHERE trkorr = @LT_log-trkorr
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_txt).
    SORT lt_txt BY trkorr langu.

    DATA: lv_cnt_ok   TYPE i,
          lv_cnt_warn TYPE i,
          lv_cnt_crit TYPE i.

    LOOP AT lt_log INTO DATA(ls_l).
      "Convert numeric return code safely (ignore non-numeric codes)
      DATA(lv_rc) = 0.
      IF ls_l-retcode CO ' 0123456789'.
        lv_rc = CONV i( ls_l-retcode ).
      ELSE.
        lv_rc = 12.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_rc >= 8.
        lv_cnt_crit = lv_cnt_crit + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_rc >= 4.
        lv_cnt_warn = lv_cnt_warn + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_cnt_ok = lv_cnt_ok + 1.
      ENDIF.

      "Find description (prefer logon language, else any language)
      DATA(lv_text) = VALUE as4text( ).
      READ TABLE lt_txt INTO DATA(ls_t) WITH KEY trkorr = ls_l-trkorr langu = sy-langu BINARY SEARCH.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        READ TABLE lt_txt INTO ls_t WITH KEY trkorr = ls_l-trkorr.
      ENDIF.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_text = ls_t-as4text.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE ty_imp(
        trkorr  = ls_l-trkorr
        retcode = lv_rc
        rc_raw  = ls_l-retcode
        impdate = ls_l-trtime(8)
        imptime = ls_l-trtime+8(6)
        impuser = COND #( WHEN ls_l-admin IS NOT INITIAL THEN ls_l-admin ELSE ls_l-truser )
        as4text = lv_text ) TO lt_imp.
    ENDLOOP.

    "Overall summary detail row
    DATA(lv_tot) = lines( lt_imp ).
    DATA(lv_ov_sev) = COND int1( WHEN lv_cnt_crit > 0 THEN gc_crit
                                 WHEN lv_cnt_warn > 0 THEN gc_warn
                                 ELSE gc_ok ).
    add( iv_server = sy-sysid
         iv_metric = 'Transport imports in window'
         iv_value  = lv_tot
         iv_vtxt   = |Total: { lv_tot } (RC0: { lv_cnt_ok }, RC4: { lv_cnt_warn }, RC>=8: { lv_cnt_crit })|
         iv_warn   = 4
         iv_crit   = 8
         iv_sev    = lv_ov_sev
         iv_msg    = COND string( WHEN lv_cnt_crit > 0 THEN |{ lv_cnt_crit } transport(s) failed with RC >= 8|
                                  WHEN lv_cnt_warn > 0 THEN |{ lv_cnt_warn } transport(s) imported with RC = 4 (Warning)|
                                  ELSE |All { lv_tot } transport(s) imported with RC = 0| ) ).

    "Sort details: highest RC first, then newest date/time first
    SORT lt_imp BY retcode DESCENDING impdate DESCENDING imptime DESCENDING.

    LOOP AT lt_imp INTO DATA(ls_imp) TO p_maxdt.
      DATA(lv_row_sev) = COND int1( WHEN ls_imp-retcode >= 8 THEN gc_crit
                                    WHEN ls_imp-retcode >= 4 THEN gc_warn
                                    ELSE gc_info ).
      add( iv_server = sy-sysid
           iv_metric = |Import { ls_imp-trkorr }|
           iv_object = ls_imp-as4text
           iv_value  = ls_imp-retcode
           iv_vtxt   = |RC={ ls_imp-retcode } ({ ls_imp-rc_raw })|
           iv_unit   = 'RC'
           iv_warn   = 4
           iv_crit   = 8
           iv_date   = ls_imp-impdate
           iv_time   = ls_imp-imptime
           iv_user   = ls_imp-impuser
           iv_sev    = lv_row_sev
           iv_msg    = ls_imp-as4text ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk_ssl.
    DATA: lt_list  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF abaplist,
          lt_ascii TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF char255,
          lv_pse   TYPE char40,
          lv_days  TYPE i,
          lv_exp_d TYPE d,
          lv_found TYPE abap_bool.

    "Run SAP standard report SSF_ALERT_CERTEXPIRE and capture its output list
    SUBMIT ssf_alert_certexpire
      EXPORTING LIST TO MEMORY
      AND RETURN.

    CALL FUNCTION 'LIST_FROM_MEMORY'
      TABLES
        listobject = lt_list
      EXCEPTIONS
        not_found  = 1
        OTHERS     = 2.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lt_list IS INITIAL.
      add( iv_metric = 'SSF_ALERT_CERTEXPIRE'
           iv_sev    = gc_nchk
           iv_msg    = 'No output returned by standard report SSF_ALERT_CERTEXPIRE' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CALL FUNCTION 'LIST_TO_ASCI'
      TABLES
        listasci   = lt_ascii
        listobject = lt_list
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1.

    CALL FUNCTION 'LIST_FREE_MEMORY'
      TABLES
        listobject = lt_list.

    "Parse SSF_ALERT_CERTEXPIRE output lines
    LOOP AT lt_ascii INTO DATA(lv_raw).
      DATA(lv_line) = condense( val = CONV string( lv_raw ) ).
      IF lv_line IS INITIAL OR lv_line CO '-=*_'.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      "Skip standard report title/header lines
      IF lv_line CP 'SAP*' AND sy-tabix <= 3.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      "Track current PSE context if line mentions PSE
      IF lv_line CP '*PSE*' OR lv_line CP '*.pse*'.
        lv_pse = CONV char40( lv_line ).
      ENDIF.

      "Look for date pattern YYYY.MM.DD, DD.MM.YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, or YYYYMMDD in line
      CLEAR: lv_exp_d, lv_days.
      DATA(lv_has_date) = abap_false.

      FIND REGEX '(\d{2})\.(\d{2})\.(\d{4})' IN lv_line SUBMATCHES DATA(lv_d1) DATA(lv_m1) DATA(lv_y1).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_exp_d    = |{ lv_y1 }{ lv_m1 }{ lv_d1 }|.
        lv_has_date = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        FIND REGEX '(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})' IN lv_line SUBMATCHES DATA(lv_y2) DATA(lv_m2) DATA(lv_d2).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_exp_d    = |{ lv_y2 }{ lv_m2 }{ lv_d2 }|.
          lv_has_date = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          FIND REGEX '(\d{2})/(\d{2})/(\d{4})' IN lv_line SUBMATCHES DATA(lv_m3) DATA(lv_d3) DATA(lv_y3).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lv_exp_d    = |{ lv_y3 }{ lv_m3 }{ lv_d3 }|.
            lv_has_date = abap_true.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      lv_found = abap_true.

      IF lv_has_date = abap_true AND lv_exp_d IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_days = lv_exp_d - sy-datum.
        DATA(lv_sev) = rate_down( iv_val = lv_days iv_w = p_ssw iv_h = p_ssh iv_c = p_ssc ).
        add( iv_server = lv_pse
             iv_metric = 'Certificate validity'
             iv_object = CONV char80( lv_line )
             iv_value  = lv_days
             iv_vtxt   = COND string( WHEN lv_days < 0 THEN |EXPIRED ({ lv_days } d)|
                                      ELSE |{ lv_days } days left| )
             iv_unit   = 'days'
             iv_warn   = p_ssw
             iv_high   = p_ssh
             iv_crit   = p_ssc
             iv_dir    = 'L'
             iv_date   = lv_exp_d
             iv_sev    = lv_sev
             iv_msg    = lv_line ).
      ELSE.
        "Output line without explicit date (e.g. warning/error/PSE header line from SSF_ALERT_CERTEXPIRE)
        DATA(lv_lsev) = COND int1(
          WHEN lv_line CP '*expired*' OR lv_line CP '*EXPIRED*' OR lv_line CP '*Error*'   THEN gc_crit
          WHEN lv_line CP '*expires*' OR lv_line CP '*Warning*' OR lv_line CP '*warn*'    THEN gc_warn
          ELSE gc_info ).
        add( iv_server = lv_pse
             iv_metric = 'SSF_ALERT_CERTEXPIRE'
             iv_object = CONV char80( lv_line )
             iv_sev    = lv_lsev
             iv_msg    = lv_line ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_found = abap_false.
      add( iv_metric = 'SSL certificate check (SSF_ALERT_CERTEXPIRE)'
           iv_value  = 0
           iv_vtxt   = 'No expiring certificates reported'
           iv_sev    = gc_ok
           iv_msg    = 'SSF_ALERT_CERTEXPIRE finished with no warnings' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk_sost.
    DATA: lv_err  TYPE i,
          lv_wait TYPE i.

    DATA(lv_where) = dt_where( iv_df = 'ENTRY_DATE' iv_tf = 'ENTRY_TIME' ).

    "Read SAPconnect status log table SOST in time window
    SELECT rectp, recyr, recno, entry_date, entry_time,
           msgty, msgid, msgno, msgv1
      FROM sost
      WHERE (lv_where)
      ORDER BY rectp, recyr, recno, entry_date DESCENDING, entry_time DESCENDING
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sost).

    "Keep only the latest status per send request (rectp + recyr + recno)
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_sost COMPARING rectp recyr recno.

    "Keep only requests whose current/latest status is Error (E/A) or Waiting (W)
    DATA lt_prob LIKE lt_sost.
    LOOP AT lt_sost INTO DATA(ls_s).
      IF ls_s-msgty = 'E' OR ls_s-msgty = 'A'.
        lv_err = lv_err + 1.
        APPEND ls_s TO lt_prob.
      ELSEIF ls_s-msgty = 'W'.
        lv_wait = lv_wait + 1.
        APPEND ls_s TO lt_prob.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_tot) = lv_err + lv_wait.
    DATA(lv_sev) = rate_up( iv_val = lv_tot iv_w = p_sow iv_h = p_soh iv_c = p_soc ).

    add( iv_metric = 'Failed / waiting mails in window'
         iv_value  = lv_tot
         iv_vtxt   = |Failed: { lv_err }, Waiting: { lv_wait }|
         iv_warn   = p_sow
         iv_high   = p_soh
         iv_crit   = p_soc
         iv_sev    = lv_sev
         iv_msg    = COND string( WHEN lv_tot = 0 THEN 'No failed or waiting send requests in window'
                                  ELSE |{ lv_err } failed, { lv_wait } waiting send request(s) in SOST| ) ).

    "Sort: Errors first, then newest first
    SORT lt_prob BY msgty ASCENDING entry_date DESCENDING entry_time DESCENDING.

    LOOP AT lt_prob INTO DATA(ls) TO p_maxdt.
      DATA(lv_is_err) = xsdbool( ls-msgty = 'E' OR ls-msgty = 'A' ).

      "Format readable SAPconnect status message
      DATA(lv_st_msg) = VALUE string( ).
      IF ls-msgid IS NOT INITIAL AND ls-msgno IS NOT INITIAL.
        MESSAGE ID ls-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER ls-msgno WITH ls-msgv1 INTO lv_st_msg.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_st_msg IS INITIAL.
        lv_st_msg = |Message { ls-msgid }-{ ls-msgno } ({ ls-msgty })|.
      ENDIF.

      add( iv_metric = COND string( WHEN lv_is_err = abap_true THEN 'Mail FAILED' ELSE 'Mail WAITING' )
           iv_object = |{ ls-rectp }{ ls-recyr }{ ls-recno }|
           iv_value  = 1
           iv_vtxt   = |Type { ls-msgty } ({ ls-msgid } { ls-msgno })|
           iv_date   = ls-entry_date
           iv_time   = ls-entry_time
           iv_sev    = COND #( WHEN lv_is_err = abap_true THEN gc_high ELSE gc_warn )
           iv_msg    = lv_st_msg ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD chk_hana_alert.
    "rating: 1 info, 2 low, 3 medium, 4 high, 5 error
    DATA: lt_cur  TYPE tt_sql,
          lt_hist TYPE tt_sql.

    "1. Always read CURRENT active alerts (matches DBACOCKPIT -> Current Status -> Alerts)
    TRY.
        lt_cur = sql( |SELECT TO_VARCHAR(ALERT_TIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), | &&
                      |TO_VARCHAR(ALERT_RATING), TO_VARCHAR(ALERT_ID), | &&
                      |ALERT_NAME, SUBSTRING(ALERT_DETAILS,1,200) | &&
                      |FROM _SYS_STATISTICS.STATISTICS_CURRENT_ALERTS | &&
                      |WHERE ALERT_RATING >= 2 | &&
                      |ORDER BY ALERT_RATING DESC, ALERT_TIMESTAMP DESC| ).
      CATCH cx_sql_exception ##NO_HANDLER.
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lt_cur INTO DATA(ls_c).
      DATA(lv_csev) = COND int1( WHEN ls_c-c2 = '5' THEN gc_crit
                                 WHEN ls_c-c2 = '4' THEN gc_high
                                 WHEN ls_c-c2 = '3' THEN gc_warn
                                 ELSE gc_warn ).
      add( iv_metric = |Current Alert { ls_c-c3 } ({ ls_c-c4 })|
           iv_object = |Rating { ls_c-c2 }|
           iv_value  = CONV decfloat34( ls_c-c2 )
           iv_vtxt   = ls_c-c1
           iv_sev    = lv_csev
           iv_msg    = ls_c-c5 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    "2. Also read historical alerts in the selected time window (grouped per day & alert ID)
    DATA(lv_from) = |{ ms_win-d_from DATE = ISO } { ms_win-t_from TIME = ISO }|.
    DATA(lv_to)   = |{ ms_win-d_to DATE = ISO } { ms_win-t_to TIME = ISO }|.
    TRY.
        lt_hist = sql( |SELECT TO_VARCHAR(ALERT_TIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_VARCHAR(ALERT_RATING), | &&
                       |TO_VARCHAR(ALERT_ID), TO_VARCHAR(COUNT(*)), MAX(SUBSTRING(ALERT_DETAILS,1,200)) | &&
                       |FROM _SYS_STATISTICS.STATISTICS_ALERTS_BASE | &&
                       |WHERE ALERT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN '{ lv_from }' AND '{ lv_to }' AND ALERT_RATING >= 2 | &&
                       |GROUP BY TO_VARCHAR(ALERT_TIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD'), ALERT_RATING, ALERT_ID | &&
                       |ORDER BY 2 DESC, 4 DESC| ).
      CATCH cx_sql_exception ##NO_HANDLER.
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lt_hist INTO DATA(ls) TO p_maxdt.
      DATA(lv_sev) = COND int1( WHEN ls-c2 = '5' THEN gc_crit
                                WHEN ls-c2 = '4' THEN gc_high
                                WHEN ls-c2 = '3' THEN gc_warn
                                ELSE gc_warn ).
      DATA(lv_cnt) = CONV decfloat34( ls-c4 ).
      add( iv_metric = |History Alert { ls-c3 } (rating { ls-c2 })|
           iv_vtxt   = ls-c1
           iv_value  = lv_cnt
           iv_msg    = ls-c5
           iv_sev    = lv_sev ).
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_cur IS INITIAL AND lt_hist IS INITIAL.
      add( iv_metric = 'HANA alerts (current & window)'
           iv_value  = 0
           iv_vtxt   = '0 active alerts'
           iv_sev    = gc_ok
           iv_msg    = 'No active HANA alerts and no alerts in time window' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk_hana_backup.
    DATA: lv_ok_full TYPE int8 VALUE -1, lv_ok_log TYPE int8 VALUE -1,
          lv_fl_full TYPE int8 VALUE -1, lv_fl_log TYPE int8 VALUE -1,
          lv_val     TYPE decfloat34,
          lv_logmode TYPE string VALUE 'normal'.

    "Check HANA log_mode (normal vs overwrite)
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_ini) = sql( |SELECT VALUE, '', '', '', '' FROM SYS.M_INIFILE_CONTENTS | &&
                            |WHERE FILE_NAME = 'global.ini' AND SECTION = 'persistence' AND KEY = 'log_mode' | &&
                            |ORDER BY LAYER_NAME DESC| ).
        IF lt_ini IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_logmode = to_lower( lt_ini[ 1 ]-c1 ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sql_exception ##NO_HANDLER.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lt) = sql( |SELECT ENTRY_TYPE_NAME, STATE_NAME, | &&
                    |TO_VARCHAR(MAX(UTC_END_TIME),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), | &&
                    |TO_VARCHAR(SECONDS_BETWEEN(MAX(UTC_END_TIME), CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP)), '' | &&
                    |FROM SYS.M_BACKUP_CATALOG | &&
                    |WHERE ENTRY_TYPE_NAME IN ('complete data backup','log backup') | &&
                    |GROUP BY ENTRY_TYPE_NAME, STATE_NAME| ).
    LOOP AT lt INTO DATA(ls).
      DATA(lv_age) = CONV int8( ls-c4 ).
      CASE ls-c1.
        WHEN 'complete data backup'.
          IF ls-c2 = 'successful'. lv_ok_full = lv_age. ELSEIF ls-c2 = 'failed'. lv_fl_full = lv_age. ENDIF.
        WHEN 'log backup'.
          IF ls-c2 = 'successful'. lv_ok_log = lv_age. ELSEIF ls-c2 = 'failed'. lv_fl_log = lv_age. ENDIF.
      ENDCASE.
      lv_val = round( val = CONV decfloat34( lv_age ) / 3600 dec = 2 ).
      add( iv_metric = |{ ls-c1 } - last { ls-c2 }| iv_vtxt = |{ ls-c3 } UTC|
           iv_value = lv_val iv_unit = 'hours ago' iv_sev = gc_info ).
    ENDLOOP.

    "Full data backup check
    lv_val = COND #( WHEN lv_ok_full >= 0 THEN round( val = CONV decfloat34( lv_ok_full ) / 3600 dec = 2 ) ELSE -1 ).
    add( iv_metric = 'Last successful full backup age' iv_value = lv_val iv_unit = 'hours'
         iv_crit = p_bkfh
         iv_sev = COND #( WHEN lv_ok_full < 0 OR lv_ok_full > CONV int8( p_bkfh ) * 3600 THEN gc_crit
                          WHEN lv_fl_full >= 0 AND lv_fl_full < lv_ok_full              THEN gc_high
                          ELSE gc_ok )
         iv_msg = COND string( WHEN lv_fl_full >= 0 AND lv_fl_full < lv_ok_full
                               THEN `A failed full backup is newer than the last successful one`
                               ELSE |Last full backup { lv_val } hours ago| ) ).

    "Log backup check (aware of log_mode = overwrite)
    lv_val = COND #( WHEN lv_ok_log >= 0 THEN round( val = CONV decfloat34( lv_ok_log ) / 60 dec = 1 ) ELSE -1 ).
    IF lv_logmode = 'overwrite'.
      add( iv_metric = 'Log backup mode'
           iv_value  = lv_val
           iv_vtxt   = |log_mode = overwrite|
           iv_unit   = 'minutes'
           iv_crit   = p_bklm
           iv_sev    = gc_warn
           iv_msg    = 'HANA log_mode is OVERWRITE (point-in-time log backups are disabled)' ).
    ELSE.
      add( iv_metric = 'Last successful log backup age' iv_value = lv_val iv_unit = 'minutes'
           iv_crit = p_bklm
           iv_sev = COND #( WHEN lv_ok_log < 0 OR lv_ok_log > CONV int8( p_bklm ) * 60 THEN gc_crit
                            WHEN lv_fl_log >= 0 AND lv_fl_log < lv_ok_log              THEN gc_high
                            ELSE gc_ok ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk_hana_mem.
    DATA(lt) = sql( |SELECT HOST, | &&
                    |TO_VARCHAR(ROUND(INSTANCE_TOTAL_MEMORY_USED_SIZE/1024/1024/1024,1)), | &&
                    |TO_VARCHAR(ROUND(ALLOCATION_LIMIT/1024/1024/1024,1)), | &&
                    |TO_VARCHAR(ROUND(100*INSTANCE_TOTAL_MEMORY_USED_SIZE/ALLOCATION_LIMIT,1)), '' | &&
                    |FROM SYS.M_HOST_RESOURCE_UTILIZATION| ).
    LOOP AT lt INTO DATA(ls).
      DATA(lv_pct) = CONV decfloat34( ls-c4 ).
      add( iv_server = ls-c1 iv_metric = 'HANA memory used vs allocation limit'
           iv_value = lv_pct iv_unit = '%' iv_vtxt = |{ ls-c2 } GB of { ls-c3 } GB|
           iv_warn = p_mmw iv_high = p_mmh iv_crit = p_mmc
           iv_sev = rate_up( iv_val = lv_pct iv_w = p_mmw iv_h = p_mmh iv_c = p_mmc ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk_hana_cpu.
    DATA(lv_from) = |{ ms_win-d_from DATE = ISO } { ms_win-t_from TIME = ISO }|.
    DATA(lv_to)   = |{ ms_win-d_to DATE = ISO } { ms_win-t_to TIME = ISO }|.
    DATA(lt) = sql( |SELECT HOST, TO_VARCHAR(ROUND(AVG(CPU),1)), TO_VARCHAR(ROUND(MAX(CPU),1)), '', '' | &&
                    |FROM SYS.M_LOAD_HISTORY_HOST | &&
                    |WHERE TIME BETWEEN '{ lv_from }' AND '{ lv_to }' GROUP BY HOST| ).
    LOOP AT lt INTO DATA(ls).
      DATA(lv_avg) = CONV decfloat34( ls-c2 ).
      add( iv_server = ls-c1 iv_metric = 'HANA host CPU (avg in window)'
           iv_value = lv_avg iv_unit = '%' iv_vtxt = |Peak { ls-c3 } %|
           iv_warn = p_cpw iv_high = p_cph iv_crit = p_cpc
           iv_sev = rate_up( iv_val = lv_avg iv_w = p_cpw iv_h = p_cph iv_c = p_cpc ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk_hana_disk.

                    |FROM SYS.M_DISKS WHERE TOTAL_SIZE > 0| ).
    LOOP AT lt INTO DATA(ls).
      DATA(lv_pct) = CONV decfloat34( ls-c3 ).
      add( iv_server = ls-c1 iv_metric = |Disk { ls-c2 }| iv_object = ls-c5

*======================================================================*
* Persistence & housekeeping
*======================================================================*
  METHOD save.
    DATA ls_run TYPE zbc_hc_run.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_end).

    LOOP AT mt_res INTO DATA(ls) WHERE rec_type = 'S'.
      CASE ls-severity.
        WHEN gc_crit. ls_run-cnt_crit = ls_run-cnt_crit + 1.
        WHEN gc_high. ls_run-cnt_high = ls_run-cnt_high + 1.
        WHEN gc_warn. ls_run-cnt_warn = ls_run-cnt_warn + 1.
        WHEN gc_nchk. ls_run-cnt_nchk = ls_run-cnt_nchk + 1.
      ENDCASE.
      IF ls-severity <> gc_nchk AND ls-severity > ls_run-max_sev.
        ls_run-max_sev = ls-severity.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    ls_run-mandt      = sy-mandt.
    ls_run-run_id     = mv_run_id.
    ls_run-sysid      = sy-sysid.
    ls_run-variant    = sy-slset.
    ls_run-run_date   = sy-datum.
    ls_run-run_time   = sy-uzeit.
    ls_run-win_mode   = mv_mode.
    ls_run-win_from   = ms_win-ts_from.
    ls_run-win_to     = ms_win-ts_to.
    ls_run-uname      = sy-uname.
    ls_run-batch      = sy-batch.
    ls_run-status     = 'S'.
    ls_run-duration_s = ts_secs( lv_end ) - ts_secs( mv_start ).

    INSERT zbc_hc_run FROM @LS_run.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      INSERT zbc_hc_res FROM TABLE @MT_res.
    ENDIF.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      MESSAGE 'Health check results could not be saved' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup.
    "retention: never below 7 days, deletes results first, then headers
    DATA(lv_cut) = CONV d( sy-datum - nmax( val1 = CONV i( p_keep ) val2 = 7 ) ).
    DELETE FROM zbc_hc_res
      WHERE run_id IN ( SELECT run_id FROM zbc_hc_run WHERE run_date < @LV_cut ).
    DELETE FROM zbc_hc_run WHERE run_date < @LV_cut.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

*======================================================================*
* ALV
*======================================================================*
  METHOD get_details.
    rt = to_out( VALUE #( FOR r IN mt_res WHERE ( check_id = iv_check AND rec_type = 'D' ) ( r ) ) ).
    SORT rt BY severity DESCENDING server metric.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_out.
    LOOP AT it_res ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_res>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<o>).
      <o> = CORRESPONDING #( <ls_res> ).
      <o>-icon = SWITCH #( <o>-severity
                   WHEN gc_ok   THEN icon_led_green
                   WHEN gc_info THEN icon_information
                   WHEN gc_warn THEN icon_led_yellow
                   WHEN gc_high THEN icon_warning
                   WHEN gc_crit THEN icon_led_red
                   ELSE icon_light_out ).
      <o>-sev_txt = SWITCH #( <o>-severity
                   WHEN gc_ok   THEN 'OK'
                   WHEN gc_info THEN 'INFO'
                   WHEN gc_warn THEN 'WARNING'
                   WHEN gc_high THEN 'HIGH'
                   WHEN gc_crit THEN 'CRITICAL'
                   ELSE 'NOT CHECKED' ).
      DATA(lv_col) = SWITCH i( <o>-severity
                   WHEN gc_ok   THEN 5      "green
                   WHEN gc_info THEN 4      "blue
                   WHEN gc_warn THEN 3      "yellow
                   WHEN gc_high THEN 7      "orange
                   WHEN gc_crit THEN 6      "red
                   ELSE 1 ).                "grey-blue
      <o>-t_color = VALUE #( ( color-col = lv_col color-int = 0 color-inv = 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD show_alv.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_txt, col TYPE lvc_fname, txt TYPE scrtext_m, END OF ty_txt,
           tt_txt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_txt WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_out TYPE tt_out.
    lt_out = it_out.                      "lives while the ALV is displayed

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( IMPORTING r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
                                CHANGING  t_table      = lt_out ).
        lo_alv->get_functions( )->set_all( abap_true ).
        DATA(lo_cols) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        lo_cols->set_optimize( abap_true ).
        lo_cols->set_color_column( 'T_COLOR' ).

        DATA(lt_txt) = VALUE tt_txt(
          ( col = 'ICON'      txt = 'Status' )      ( col = 'SEVERITY' txt = 'Sev.' )
          ( col = 'SEV_TXT'   txt = 'Severity' )    ( col = 'CHECK_GRP' txt = 'Area' )
          ( col = 'CHECK_ID'  txt = 'Check' )       ( col = 'SERVER'   txt = 'Server/Client' )
          ( col = 'METRIC'    txt = 'Metric' )      ( col = 'OBJECT'   txt = 'Object' )
          ( col = 'VAL_NUM'   txt = 'Value' )       ( col = 'VAL_TXT'  txt = 'Value text' )
          ( col = 'UNIT'      txt = 'Unit' )        ( col = 'THR_WARN' txt = 'Warn' )
          ( col = 'THR_HIGH'  txt = 'High' )        ( col = 'THR_CRIT' txt = 'Critical' )
          ( col = 'EVT_DATE'  txt = 'Date' )        ( col = 'EVT_TIME' txt = 'Time' )
          ( col = 'EVT_USER'  txt = 'User' )        ( col = 'MESSAGE'  txt = 'Message' )
          ( col = 'TCODE'     txt = 'Tcode' ) ).
        LOOP AT lt_txt INTO DATA(ls_t).
          DATA(lo_col) = CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( ls_t-col ) ).
          lo_col->set_long_text( CONV #( ls_t-txt ) ).
          lo_col->set_medium_text( ls_t-txt ).
          lo_col->set_short_text( CONV #( ls_t-txt ) ).
        ENDLOOP.
        CAST cl_salv_column_table( lo_cols->get_column( 'ICON' ) )->set_icon( abap_true ).
        IF iv_detail = abap_false.         "summary: hide detail-only columns
          DATA(lt_hide) = VALUE string_table( ( `SERVER` ) ( `OBJECT` ) ( `VAL_TXT` ) ( `UNIT` )
                                              ( `THR_WARN` ) ( `THR_HIGH` ) ( `THR_CRIT` )
                                              ( `EVT_DATE` ) ( `EVT_TIME` ) ( `EVT_USER` ) ).
          LOOP AT lt_hide INTO DATA(lv_hide).
            lo_cols->get_column( CONV #( lv_hide ) )->set_visible( abap_false ).
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

        lo_alv->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( CONV #( iv_title ) ).
        DATA(lo_evt) = NEW lcl_evt( io_hc = me iv_detail = iv_detail ir_out = REF #( lt_out ) ).
        SET HANDLER lo_evt->on_dbl FOR lo_alv->get_event( ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_not_found cx_salv_data_error INTO DATA(lx).
        MESSAGE lx->get_text( ) TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
